verses.translation: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes
By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane
You will certainly have a never-ending reward
And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character
Soon you and the pagans will see
which of you is mad

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verses.translation: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
So do not give in to the deniers
They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺
And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker
slanderer, gossip-monger
withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer
brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child
Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children

verses.arabicText: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.translation: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
We will soon mark his snout

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innā balawnāhum kamā balawnā aṣḥāba l-janati idh aqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣ'biḥīn
verses.translation: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning
leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

verses.arabicText: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāifum-min rabbika wahum nāimūn
verses.translation: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept
so it was reduced to ashes
Then by daybreak they called out to each other

verses.arabicText: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīn
verses.translation: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”
So they went off, whispering to one another

verses.arabicText: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
verses.translation: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”
And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose
But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way
In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūn
verses.translation: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.translation: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
Then they turned on each other, throwing blame
They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors

verses.arabicText: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: ʿasā rabbunā ay-yub'dilanā khayram-min'hā innā ilā rabbinā rāghibūn
verses.translation: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti n-naʿīm
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord
Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked
What is the matter with you? How do you judge
Or do you have a scripture, in which you read
that you will have whatever you choose

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūn
verses.translation: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide
Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqiw-wayud'ʿawna ilā s-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūn
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so

verses.arabicText: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatuw-waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā s-sujūdi wahum sālimūn
verses.translation: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fadharnī wamay-yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend
I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum mim-maghramin muth'qalūn
verses.translation: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress

verses.arabicText: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matum-min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun
verses.translation: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-iy-yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū dh-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun
verses.translation: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
But it is simply a reminder to the whole world
